safe.label: Looks legitimate
safe.description: No strong scam pattern found. Genuine alerts usually don't ask you to click links or share OTP/PIN.
safe.description_hl: Koi strong scam pattern nahi mila. Asli alerts link click karne ya OTP/PIN share karne ko nahi kehte.

fake_kyc.label: Fake KYC / account block scam
fake_kyc.description: Scammers claim your KYC has expired and your account will be blocked, then push you to a fake link or ask for OTP, Aadhaar or PAN to empty your account.
fake_kyc.description_hl: Scammer bolta hai KYC expire ho gaya aur account block hoga, phir fake link par le jaata hai ya OTP/Aadhaar/PAN maangta hai.
advice: Banks don't do KYC through SMS links or phone calls. Visit your branch or use the official app.
Don't click the link or call the number given in the message.
advice_hl: Bank SMS link ya call par KYC nahi karta. Branch jao ya official app use karo.
Message ka link click mat karo aur diye gaye number par call mat karo.

payment_trap.label: UPI refund / collect-request scam
payment_trap.description: Scammers send a 'collect request' or claim they paid you by mistake, so you approve the request or enter your UPI PIN and lose money.
payment_trap.description_hl: Scammer 'collect request' bhejta hai ya bolta hai galti se paise bhej diye, taaki aap request approve karo ya UPI PIN dalo aur paise kat jaayein.
advice: You never need to enter your UPI PIN or accept a request to receive money.
If someone says they paid you by mistake, check your bank balance and ask them to reverse it through their own bank.
advice_hl: Paise receive karne ke liye UPI PIN dalna ya request accept karna kabhi nahi padta.
Agar koi bole galti se paise bheje, apna balance check karo aur use apne bank se reverse karwane ko bolo.

lottery_prize.label: Lottery / prize scam
lottery_prize.description: You're told you've won a lottery, KBC draw or free gift, then asked to pay a 'processing fee' or share details to claim it.
lottery_prize.description_hl: Aapko bola jaata hai lottery, KBC ya free gift jeeta hai, phir 'processing fee' ya details maangte hain.
advice: You can't win a lottery you never entered. Genuine prizes never need a fee.
advice_hl: Jo lottery aapne bhari hi nahi, wo jeet nahi sakte. Asli inaam ke liye fee nahi lagti.
Sender ko block aur report karo.

job_offer.label: Fake job / easy-earning scam
job_offer.description: Easy work-from-home jobs with high daily pay, where you must first pay a registration fee or complete 'tasks' that lead to a deposit trap.
job_offer.description_hl: Ghar baithe aasan kaam aur high daily pay ka lalach, par pehle registration fee ya 'tasks' ke naam par paise jama karwate hain.
advice: Genuine employers don't charge registration or joining fees.
Check the company on its official website and LinkedIn before replying.
advice_hl: Asli company registration ya joining fee nahi leti.
Reply karne se pehle company ko official website aur LinkedIn par check karo.

utility_threat.label: Utility / SIM disconnection scam
utility_threat.description: A message says your electricity or SIM will be cut tonight unless you call an 'officer' or update details via a link.
utility_threat.description_hl: Message bolta hai aaj raat bijli ya SIM kat jaayegi jab tak aap 'officer' ko call na karo ya link se details update na karo.
advice: Electricity boards don't threaten disconnection through random numbers. Check your bill on the official app or website.
Don't call back numbers given in such messages.
advice_hl: Bijli board random number se disconnection ki dhamki nahi deta. Bill official app ya website par check karo.
Aise message ke number par call back mat karo.

urgency.label: Creates urgency
urgency.explanation: Scammers rush you so you don't have time to think or verify.
urgency.explanation_hl: Scammer jaldi karne ka pressure dalte hain taaki aap sochne ya check karne ka time na lo.

threat.label: Threatens account or service
threat.label_hl: Account ya service band karne ki dhamki
threat.explanation: Fear of blocking, disconnection or legal action is used to make you act without thinking.
threat.explanation_hl: Block, disconnection ya legal action ka dar dikhake aapse bina soche kaam karwate hain.

credential_request.label: Asks for OTP / PIN / sensitive details
credential_request.label_hl: OTP / PIN / sensitive details maangta hai
credential_request.explanation: No bank or genuine company ever asks you to share your OTP, PIN, CVV or password.
credential_request.explanation_hl: Asli bank ya company kabhi OTP, PIN, CVV ya password share karne ko nahi kehti.

payment_request.label: Pushes you to accept a payment request / scan QR
payment_request.label_hl: Payment request accept ya QR scan karwata hai
payment_request.explanation: Receiving money never needs a PIN, a QR scan or accepting a request. Doing so sends money out of your account.
payment_request.explanation_hl: Paise receive karne ke liye PIN, QR scan ya request accept nahi karna padta. Aisa karne par aapke paise nikalte hain.
patterns: \b(?:collect request|payment request|accept(?: the)? request|approve(?: the)? request)\b

prize_bait.label: Promises a prize or gift
prize_bait.explanation: Unexpected prizes are bait to collect fees or personal details.
prize_bait.explanation_hl: Achanak mile inaam ka lalach fee ya personal details nikalne ke liye hota hai.

remote_access.label: Asks you to install an app / screen-sharing tool
remote_access.label_hl: App install ya screen-sharing tool maangta hai
remote_access.explanation: Apps like AnyDesk let a scammer see and control your phone and approve payments.
remote_access.explanation_hl: AnyDesk jaisi apps se scammer aapka phone control karke payments approve kar sakta hai.

job_bait.label: Easy-money or fee-for-job offer
job_bait.label_hl: Aasan kamai ya job ke liye fee ka lalach
job_bait.explanation: Genuine jobs don't charge you to join, and high pay for simple tasks is a common lure.
job_bait.explanation_hl: Asli job me join karne ke paise nahi lagte, aur aasan kaam ke bade paise ka vaada aksar jaal hota hai.

fake_authority.label: Claims to be from a known organisation
fake_authority.label_hl: Kisi jaani-maani sanstha ka naam leta hai
fake_authority.explanation: Scammers borrow the name of banks, RBI, tax or utility departments to look trustworthy. Verify through the official app or website.
fake_authority.explanation_hl: Scammer bank, RBI, tax ya bijli vibhag ka naam use karke bharosa jeetne ki koshish karte hain. Official app ya website se verify karo.
patterns: \b(?:rbi|npci|sbi|hdfc|icici|axis bank|kotak|pnb|paytm|phonepe|google ?pay|gpay|income tax|customs|cbi|trai|electricity board|mseb|adani electricity|tata power|customer care|kyc team|bank officer)\b

suspicious_link.label: Contains a link
suspicious_link.explanation: Links in unexpected messages can lead to fake websites that steal your details.
suspicious_link.explanation_hl: Anjaan message ke link fake website par le ja sakte hain jo aapki details chura leti hai.
